name: Open ParaBank Savings Account
description: Logs into ParaBank with vaulted credentials (PARABANK_USERNAME / PARABANK_PASSWORD), opens a new SAVINGS account funded from the funding account the Open New Account form pre-selects by default, and returns the new account number as `newAccountNumber`. Submitting the application is irreversible and requires human approval on each replay. Business outcomes: LOGIN_REJECTED (credentials not verified) and ACCOUNT_OPEN_FAILED (confirmation not shown, e.g. minimum $100 opening deposit cannot be met or the request errored).

newAccountNumber.description: The account number of the newly opened SAVINGS account, shown on the confirmation page.

outcomes.name: LOGIN_REJECTED
outcomes.description: ParaBank did not accept the credentials. It reports this with a generic internal-error page on /parabank/login.htm rather than a specific message, which is why the detector matches that wording.

outcomes.name: ACCOUNT_OPEN_FAILED
outcomes.description: ParaBank could not open the new savings account (e.g. the pre-selected funding account cannot cover the $100.00 minimum opening deposit, or the request errored). No account number is returned.

postcondition.text: Congratulations, your account is now open.

humanEdits.what: Corrected the LOGIN_REJECTED detector. Discovery took the happy path and never saw a failed login, so the model inferred the wording as "The username and password could not be verified."; the real page says "An internal error has occurred and has been logged." Verified against evidence/runs/124db8ff-b8d2-4dbf-94ec-57ca9192af01/failure.html, where the wrong wording made a genuine login rejection escalate as CHECKPOINT_FAILED.
